modifiers.name: Outbreak
modifiers.desc: Increases XP gain by 10%, but only masses of class 3 zombies spawn

modifiers.name: Rifle
modifiers.desc: Increases XP gain by 25%, but only riflemen and medics can be chosen

modifiers.name: Tier 1
modifiers.desc: Increases XP by 10%. Mostly class 1 and 2 hostiles spawn. Cannot be checked with Outbreak.

modifiers.name: 1 life
modifiers.desc: Increases XP gain by 15%. No revives or reinforcements on death. Requires 3+ players.

modifiers.name: Training
modifiers.desc: Training mode (12 of each class) (XP and bank saving disabled)

modifiers.name: Blizzard
modifiers.desc: reduces movespeed by 0.15, visionrange by 3, impossible to pick ali, and increases energy regen by 0.25. XP gain +15%.

modifiers.name: Sushis
modifiers.desc: Sushis will infect some players - Increases XP gain by 15% + additional XP in case of Victory (be infected before the chapter 3 to unlock the April Fish camo). The Sushi modifier prevents the Rifle and Classical modifiers.

modifiers.name: Classical
modifiers.desc: Disable new UAR MOS. The Classical modifier prevents the Rifle and Sushis modifiers.

modifiers.name: Infested
modifiers.desc: tumors spawn randomly, slowing soldiers and buffing undeads. XP gain +10%.

modifiers.name: Rainy Day
modifiers.desc: Increases XP gain by 10%, the Mayor has installed a powerful missiles launcher turret at the top of his house. Asked about that surprising fact, the Mayor just said: "Yes, this is a missiles turret. The biggest I could find.".
